properties.title: Romanian political crisis deepens as parliament rejects PM nominee
properties.summary: Romania’s parliament rejected Siegfried Mureșan’s attempt to form a government Wednesday, deepening a crisis that began when the coalition collapsed in May. President Nicușor Dan, an independent moderate, proposed MEP Mureșan for the job — but lawmakers in Bucharest refused to back his candidacy in a crunch vote Wednesday.  It is the second time parliament has formally voted down Dan’s nominee, and under Romania’s constitution that means a snap election is now a possibility. properties.summary: BRUSSELS — The European Union will open its vast economy to countries waiting to join its ranks, provided they agree to stand with the bloc against hostile states and industrial rivals, according to a draft European Commission proposal obtained by POLITICO. properties.title: EU accused of hiding environmental impact of data centers
properties.summary: The European Union has shielded data centers from public scrutiny about how much energy they use, according to a formal complaint filed Monday against the European Commission. The complaint lodged this week by Lighthouse Reports, and first reported by POLITICO, accuses the EU executive of setting up rules keeping the public from seeing how much energy and water are used by individual data centers. properties.summary: DUBLIN — European energy officials highlighted handouts and tax cuts as among the few viable ways to shield consumers from surging energy costs this winter — while hoping that U.S. President Donald Trump wouldn’t add fuel to the fire by banning American diesel exports. properties.title: Iranian airliner with passengers on board seized at Istanbul over €3-million debt
properties.summary: Bailiffs boarded the Caspian Airlines Boeing 737 as passengers sat ready for departure and served a €3 million debt order before it could take off. The seizure came days after US secondary sanctions on Iran's aviation sector took effect, halving international flights at Tehran's main airport.

properties.title: Send rejected asylum-seekers out of EU ASAP, urges Greek minister

properties.title: EU is drawing up membership action plans for most promising candidates
properties.summary: BRUSSELS — The EU is developing proposals that would see the four countries closest to joining the bloc given a clear, step-by-step path toward membership — while the others languish behind. Targeted “roadmaps” are being considered for Montenegro, Ukraine, Moldova and Albania, two senior European Commission officials working on the draft proposals told POLITICO, as part of efforts to speed up the decades-long process. properties.title: Serbia’s populist president Aleksandar Vučić resigns to run for prime minister
properties.summary: Vučić not allowed to seek third presidential term and election will test his grip on rule after widespread protests Serbia’s populist president, Aleksandar Vučić, has resigned to pursue an attempt to become prime minister in an early parliamentary election that will test his firm rule in the Balkan country after nearly two years of protests. properties.title: Serbia's politicians return to TV debates ahead of parliamentary election
properties.summary: A month before the early parliamentary elections, Serbia's high ranking politicians from the ruling and opposition parties engaged in a debate on the N1 channel after a prolonged boycott between the anti-government station and officials. The ownership change provided a new opportunity for dialogue.
